title: A video about my new school life
displayTitle: Project 1 · 我的新校园生活视频

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Project 1

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A video about my new school life
sentences.ipa: /ə ˈvɪdɪəʊ əˈbaʊt maɪ ˈnjuː ˈskuːl ˈlaɪf/
sentences.meaning: 关于我的新校园生活的视频

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Each student in Class 1, Grade 7 at Sunshine Middle School plans to make a video about their new school life.
sentences.ipa: /ˈiːtʃ ˈstjuːdnt ɪn ˈklɑːs ˈwʌn, ˈgreɪd ˈsevən æt ˈsʌnʃaɪn ˈmɪdəl ˈskuːl ˈplænz tə ˌmeɪk ə ˈvɪdɪəʊ əˈbaʊt ðeə ˈnjuː ˈskuːl ˈlaɪf./
sentences.meaning: 阳光中学七年级1班的每名学生都计划制作一段介绍自己新校园生活的视频。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: They will show their videos to their family and friends.
sentences.ipa: /ˌðeɪ wɪl ˈʃəʊ ðeə ˈvɪdɪəʊz tə ðeə ˈfæmɪliː ænd ˈfrendz./
sentences.meaning: 他们将会向家人和朋友展示他们的视频。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Your teacher wants you to do the same thing.
sentences.ipa: /ˌjɔː ˈtiːtʃə ˈwɒnts juː tə ˈduː ðə ˈseɪm ˈθɪŋ./
sentences.meaning: 你的老师希望你也完成同样的任务。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A Plan

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 Think about what you want to show about your new school life in the video.
sentences.ipa: /ˈwʌn ˈθɪŋk əˈbaʊt ˌwɒt juː ˈwɒnt tə ˈʃəʊ əˈbaʊt jɔː ˈnjuː ˈskuːl ˈlaɪf ɪn ðə ˈvɪdɪəʊ./
sentences.meaning: 1 想一想你希望在视频中展示哪些新校园生活内容。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Use the table below to help you.
sentences.ipa: /ˈjuːz ðə ˈteɪbəl bɪˈləʊ tə ˈhelp juː./
sentences.meaning: 使用下表帮助你梳理内容。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Make notes of your answers.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Questions

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Answers

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Your school:

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: What is the name of your school?
sentences.ipa: /ˌwɒt ɪz ðə ˈneɪm ɒv jɔː ˈskuːl?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Is your school big or small?

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: What buildings and places are there at your school?
sentences.ipa: /ˌwɒt ˈbɪldɪŋz ænd ˈpleɪsɪz ɑː ðeə æt jɔː ˈskuːl?/
sentences.meaning: 你学校里有什么建筑和场所？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: dining hall gym library

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: computer room playground

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: lab school hall sports field
sentences.meaning: 实验室、学校礼堂、运动场

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: other(s):

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: What is your favourite place at your school?
sentences.ipa: /ˌwɒt ɪz jɔː ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈpleɪs æt jɔː ˈskuːl?/
sentences.meaning: 你在学校最喜欢的地方是什么？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Why?

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: School life:

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: What subject do you like best?

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: What do you do after school?

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: What club(s) are you in?

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: What club activities are you interested in?
sentences.ipa: /ˌwɒt ˈklʌb æˈktɪvɪtiːz ɑː juː ˈɪntrɪstɪd ˈɪn?/
sentences.meaning: 你对什么俱乐部活动感兴趣？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: What school trip(s) do you have every year?
sentences.ipa: /wɒt skuːl trɪps duː juː hæv ˈevrɪ jɪə?/
sentences.meaning: 你们每年有哪些学校旅行活动？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: New friends at school:

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Who are they?

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: What are they like?

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: What are their hobbies?

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Other:

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 Decide the details of filming the video.
sentences.ipa: /ˈtuː dɪˈsaɪd ðə ˈdiːteɪlz ɒv ˈfɪlmɪŋ ðə ˈvɪdɪəʊ./
sentences.meaning: 2 确定视频拍摄的具体安排。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I need Millie in my video.
sentences.meaning: 我的视频需要 Millie 出镜。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: • When and where will you film the video?
sentences.ipa: /ˌwen ænd ˌweə wɪl juː ˈfɪlm ðə ˈvɪdɪəʊ?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: She likes reading.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: • What will you use to film the video?
sentences.ipa: /ˌwɒt wɪl juː ˈjuːz tə ˈfɪlm ðə ˈvɪdɪəʊ?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: • Who and what do you need in your video?
sentences.ipa: /ˌhuː ænd ˌwɒt ˈduː juː ˈniːd ɪn jɔː ˈvɪdɪəʊ?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B Make

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Film your video

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: • Check the lighting around you.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Don’t film if it is too dark.
sentences.ipa: /ˈdəʊnt ˈfɪlm ɪf ɪt ɪz ˈtuː ˈdɑːk./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: • Hold the camera and point it at what you want to film.
sentences.ipa: /ˈhəʊld ðə ˈkæmərə ænd ˈpɔɪnt ɪt æt ˌwɒt juː ˈwɒnt tə ˈfɪlm./
sentences.meaning: · 拿着摄像机，对准你想拍摄的东西。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Hold it still to get a clear video.
sentences.ipa: /ˈhəʊld ɪt ˈstɪl tə get ə ˈklɪə ˈvɪdɪəʊ./
sentences.meaning: 拍摄时拿稳相机，保证画面清晰。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: • Speak clearly and loudly so the audience can hear.
sentences.ipa: /ˈspiːk ˈklɪəliː ænd ˈlaʊdliː ˌsəʊ ðiː ˈɔːdɪəns kæn ˈhɪə./
sentences.meaning: · 明确而大声地说话，使观众能听到。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: • Film your video in short parts.
sentences.meaning: • 把视频分成若干短片段拍摄。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: This will make it easy to start again if you make a mistake.
sentences.ipa: /ˌðɪs wɪl ˌmeɪk ɪt ˈiːziː tə ˈstɑːt əˈgen ɪf juː ˌmeɪk ə mɪˈsteɪk./
sentences.meaning: 这样即使拍错了，也可以方便地重新开始。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Edit your video

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: My favourite place at school is the library.
sentences.ipa: /ˌmaɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈpleɪs æt ˈskuːl ɪz ðə ˈlaɪbrəriː./
sentences.meaning: 我在学校最喜欢的地方是图书馆。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It's big and clean.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It has lots of books.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I like reading there.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: • Choose the best bits of what you have filmed and put them all together.
sentences.ipa: /ˈtʃuːz ðə ˈbest ˈbɪts ɒv ˌwɒt juː hæv ˈfɪlmd ænd ˌpʊt ˌðem ˈɔːl təˈgeðə./
sentences.meaning: · 选择你所拍摄的最好的片段，把它们集中起来。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: • Make sure your video is the right length.
sentences.ipa: /ˌmeɪk ˈʃʊə jɔː ˈvɪdɪəʊ ɪz ðə ˈraɪt ˈleŋθ./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: • Choose a piece of music to add to the video.
sentences.ipa: /ˈtʃuːz ə ˈpiːs ɒv ˈmjuːzɪk tʊ ˈæd tə ðə ˈvɪdɪəʊ./
sentences.meaning: · 选择一段音乐来加入视频。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Lively music will make it more interesting for your audience.
sentences.ipa: /ˈlaɪvliː ˈmjuːzɪk wɪl ˌmeɪk ɪt ˈmɔː ˈɪntrɪstɪŋ fɔː jɔː ˈɔːdɪəns./
sentences.meaning: 活泼的音乐会让观众更感兴趣。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: But don’t make the music too loud.
sentences.ipa: /ˌbʌt ˈdəʊnt ˌmeɪk ðə ˈmjuːzɪk ˈtuː ˈlaʊd./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: C Share

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 Share videos within your group and find out about other students’ life at school.
sentences.ipa: /ˈwʌn ˈʃeə ˈvɪdɪəʊz wɪˈðɪn jɔː ˈgruːp ænd ˈfaɪnd ˈaʊt əˈbaʊt ˈʌðə ˈstjuːdnts” ˈlaɪf æt ˈskuːl./
sentences.meaning: 1 在小组内分享视频，了解其他同学的校园生活。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 Share your video with your friends and family.
sentences.ipa: /ˈtuː ˈʃeə jɔː ˈvɪdɪəʊ wɪð jɔː ˈfrendz ænd ˈfæmɪliː./
